name: GS-Scale Host Offloading
definition: A training framework that reduces GPU memory usage by storing all Gaussian parameters and optimizer states in host (CPU) memory, transferring only a subset to the GPU on demand for each forward and backward pass.
summary: GS-Scale Host Offloading trains 3D Gaussian Splatting by storing parameters in CPU memory and transferring only subsets to the GPU, preventing out-of-memory errors while maintaining speed through system-level optimizations.
